feeds.title: Let Life Happen
feeds.description: Top-notch resource for breast cancer patients, covering such useful topics as what it's like returning to work after a breast cancer diagnosis, dealing with mammograms, and more. Barbara Jacoby is an award winning blogger that has contributed her two time breast cancer journey, patient advocacy mission and domestic abuse experience to multiple online publications and organizations that have touched readers worldwide. She share stories of her life to help and inspire others.

feeds.title: Male Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Oliver Bogler is a breast cancer survivor and Entering a World of Pink is about male breast cancer and Oliver's journey through it.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily News » Breast Cancer
feeds.description: Your source for the latest breast cancer news. ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, technology, and more from leading universities, scientific journals, and research organizations.

feeds.title: Journeying Beyond Breast Cancer
feeds.description: Covers articles on topics such as breast cancer awareness, screening, advocacy, depression, survivorship, and more. Like it would anyone, getting a breast cancer diagnosis at 34 changed Marie Ennis-O'Connor's life. And now she's working to change other people's lives, for the better, buy curating the most helpful and informative breast cancer content on the web. She also shares weekly roundups of what's going on in the rest of the breast cancer community, directing people to other women's stories.

feeds.title: I Have Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: one woman's journey through breast cancer and life...

feeds.title: National Breast Cancer Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Breast cancer stories and educational information. National Breast Cancer Foundation (NBCF) was founded in 1991 by breast cancer survivor, Janelle Hail. NBCF helps women now by providing help and inspiring hope to those affected by breast cancer through early detection, education and support services.

feeds.title: My Cancer Chic Blog
feeds.description: Style, beauty & wellness inspiration during and beyond breast cancer. Also covers articles on chemotherapy, mastectomy, reconstruction, cancer-fertility, caregivers & relationships. Anna, the voice & face behind My Cancer Chic is a Breast cancer survivor, mama after cancer, and lover of beauty, pink, style & coffee! She shares her journey & lifestyle tips in a way that inspires you to thrive through adversity with confidence and style.

feeds.title: Sharsheret Blog
feeds.description: Sharsheret is a national not-for-profit organization supporting young Jewish women and their families facing breast cancer. Our mission is to offer a community of support to women, of all Jewish backgrounds, diagnosed with breast cancer or at increased genetic risk, by fostering culturally-relevant individualized connections with networks of peers, health professionals, and related resources.

feeds.title: Surviving Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Breast Cancer news, trends and guides. Also covers articles on chemotherapy, genetic testing, lymphedema, mammograms, screenings & radiations, clinical trial and survivor stories. SurvivingBreastCancer.org empowers those diagnosed with breast cancer and their families from day one and beyond. SBC serves as an educational and virtual community platform offering support from meeting patients and their families where they are on the continuum of a cancer diagnosis.

feeds.title: Susan G. Komen Blog
feeds.description: Articles on breast cancer facts & statistics, risk factors, screening & detection, diagnosis, treatment, financial assistance & insurance, survivorship, metastatic breast cancer. Susan G. Komen is the organization that addresses breast cancer on multiple fronts such as research, community health, global outreach, and public policy initiatives in order to make the biggest impact against this disease.

feeds.title: Dam Mad About Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Cathy Leman. I help survivors of ER+/PR+ breast cancer conquer phytoestrogen food fear, eat without stress and guilt, and confidently rebuild their health after treatment. Keep up with my latest insights on nutrition, exercise, and self-care.

feeds.title: Get Up Swinging
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Lara Huffman. Get Up Swinging is my personal blog. I was diagnosed with early-stage breast cancer in September 2010 at the age of 30. Get Up Swinging blog will cover articles about advocacy, education, and a call for research.

feeds.title: Jennifer A Douglas Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer A Douglas writes to encourage, enrich, and empower those diagnosed with DCIS, Stage 0 Breast Cancer, during their diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. Areas of focus include treatment decisions, coping with side effects, emotional and mental well-being, and practical tips for seeking and receiving support.

feeds.title: After 20 Years
feeds.description: Covers articles about exploring progress in cancer research from the patient perspective, cancer research developments in many areas including new treatments, improving quality of life, understanding risk and ensuring access to care.

feeds.title: My Journey ~ In Life, LMBC CHF, & LVAD
feeds.description: Debbie Emery has bravely kept blogging through her breast cancer and other subsequent health problems, including congestive heart failure and a new breast cancer diagnosis in 2016. She details her doctor visits and procedures, shares recommendations for helpful smartphone apps as well as other blogs her readers might like, and is open and honest about her thoughts as she continues on her journey.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Breast cancer
feeds.description: All the latest breaking news on Breast Cancer. Browse The Independent's complete collection of articles and commentary on Breast Cancer.

feeds.title: Nancy's Point
feeds.description: Articles on breast cancer side effects, survivorship, treatment, diagnosis, advocacy, metastatic breast cancer and more. Nancy Stordahl is an educator, author, blogger and freelance writer sharing candidly about her breast cancer experience.

feeds.title: Breast Cancer Wellness Magazine
feeds.description: Breast Cancer Wellness news, reports and resources. Breast Cancer Wellness magazine is a vital resource for a woman newly diagnosed with breast cancer as well as any woman that has been affected through breast cancer. The mission of Breast Cancer Wellness is to support the mental, emotional, physical, spiritual and environmental healing needs of women facing breast cancer, no matter what age or stage of the journey.

feeds.title: My Sunny Side Up
feeds.description: Author Carol S documents her journey living with Stage IV Breast Cancer. She is clever, humorous, and elaborative and that reflects in her writing as she casually picks mundane topics from life and weaves wonderful stories around them providing readers with an enjoyable time.

feeds.title: The Cancer Classroom
feeds.description: Navigating my way through metastatic breast cancer while sailing into the unknown.

feeds.title: Outwitting Life
feeds.description: Loretta shares her experiences about overcoming adversity (breast cancer), staying positive, embracing change, and being grateful while keeping a sense of humor. Her goal is to inspire you to stay positive in the face of change and learn ways to start Outwitting Life.

feeds.title: Our MBC Life Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to exploring life with metastatic breast cancer from the perspective of us, the people living with this disease, and the experts who partner with us to help make our lives better.

feeds.title: Beyond Pink America Blog
feeds.description: Healing from Stage 3 HER2 Positive breast cancer without surgery, chemo or radiation. A personal wellness blog-Beyond Pink America.

feeds.title: Mommy Moondragon
feeds.description: Battling breast cancer like a bald badass superhero.

feeds.title: Simplylyane
feeds.description: My biggest concern is with my boys and the affects that these upcoming challenges will have on them. In the midst of all of this, my focus has become educating and help other women through this journey. I now have a plan in place to allow my experience to help and guide others.

feeds.title: Audrey Birt's Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about my thoughts on my own experience of breast cancer, my passion for improving health and healthcare and about heartful leadership in all areas of life.

feeds.title: Let Normal Service Resume
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Let normal service resume.

feeds.title: CHEMOBRAIN.....In The Fog
feeds.description: AnneMarie Ciccarella's bravely honest blog chronicles her experiences undergoing eight rounds of chemotherapy, including how it adversely affected her brain and ability to function, an often unreported side effect that many refer to as Chemobrain. She writes about how she's coped with and prioritized around the fog, discusses the pros and cons of certain medications in the fields of breast cancer.

feeds.title: Not Just About Cancer
feeds.description: Focusing on the little details of life after metastatic breast cancer, Laurie Kingston's charming blog is a great glimpse into her life as a mother and writer in Canada. She's currently undergoing treatment to remove new tumors that have developed in her brain, writing bluntly about the fear, sadness, and uncertainty that comes along with a cancer diagnoses.

feeds.title: Living with Stage IV Breast Cancer
feeds.description: A blog about Renee's journey through Cancerland. I'm a Stage IV breast cancer thriver, mommy, wife, and artist, learning to enjoy and appreciate life despite having a terminal disease. This is where I share my experiences and show you how to do the same.

feeds.title: Amanda and Deb's Breast Cancer Tips
feeds.description: A blog sharing news, events and memories of a truly amazing daughter, wife and friend through her journey with secondary breast cancer.

feeds.title: My Journey with Breast Cancer
feeds.description: A personal breast cancer journey blog by Melissa Bingham.

feeds.title: HIS Breast Cancer Awareness Blog
feeds.description: A Blog about Male Breast Cancer and Breast Cancer in men from HISbreastcancer.org.

feeds.title: Anna Craig Blog
feeds.description: My journey with stage 4 breast cancer by anna craig.

feeds.title: Breast Cancer News
feeds.description: Breast Cancer News is a digital news publication dedicated to offering comprehensive daily news coverage of Breast Cancer.

feeds.title: Joan Lunden » Breast Cancer
feeds.description: Up to date information from joanlunden.com about breast cancer.

feeds.title: Detrice Matthews
feeds.description: A young mum's journey through breast cancer and beyond. This British mom and blogger was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2014 at the age of 32. Here, she chronicles her struggles and triumphs, both as a parent and as someone who has had cancer in her life.

feeds.title: Caroline's Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: In addition to writing about her personal journey through breast cancer diagnosis and treatment, Caroline Ronten offers interesting commentary on the ins and outs of the evolving breast cancer and healthcare industries. She brings an insightful, down-to-earth perspective and asks the questions that so many of us on the cancer roller coaster ponder.

feeds.title: Advocates for Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: ABC unites SA's active breast cancer organisations with the driving goal of lobbying government to develop and implement an effective Breast Health Policy.

feeds.title: Dancing With Cancer: Living With Mets, The New Normal
feeds.description: I first got breast cancer in 1999 at age 39. It came back in 2002 and has metastasized (spread) to my bones, liver, brain and skin. My life is about dancing with cancer.

feeds.title: Breast Cancer? But Doctor....I hate pink!
feeds.description: Blogging my life with breast cancer, from suspicion to diagnosis to treatment. Now livin' the Stage IV Lifestyle! Terminal Cancer can be funny. Just not for very long.

feeds.title: Know Your Lemons Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on breast cancer signs, symptoms, screening and other life saving information. Our mission is to improve early detection for breast cancer worldwide through creative and empowering education. We have helped women discover the change on their breast was a potential symptom and helped save their life with that powerful knowledge.

feeds.title: Tower Cancer Research Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Dr Susan Love Foundation for Breast Cancer Research challenges the status quo to end breast cancer and improve the lives of people impacted by it now through education and advocacy. The Foundation drives collaborative, cutting-edge research with nontraditional partners, brings to light the collateral damage of treatment and seeks ways to diminish it, and interprets science to empower patients.

feeds.title: Breast Cancer Canada
feeds.description: Features patient success stories, latest cancer events, and research. The Breast Cancer Society of Canada is a national charity dedicated to funding patient-focused breast cancer research.

feeds.title: Zero Breast Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Zero Breast Cancer helps individuals and communities understand scientific research on environmental risk factors and lifestyle variables that influence breast cancers. ZBC promotes breast cancer prevention through targeted communication of evidence-based recommendations that supports health & wellness at key stages of life.

feeds.title: Breastcancer.org
feeds.description: Breast cancer research news, information on the latest treatments, screening tests, stages and breast cancer types, as well as read stories, tips, and insights about breast cancer. Breastcancer.org helps people make sense of the complex medical and personal information about breast health and breast cancer, so they can make the best decisions for their lives.

feeds.title: The Breast Cancer Research Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Covers science news, researcher Q&A, infographic, stories that inspire and fundraiser spotlights. Also covers Breast Cancer Research Foundation news and events. The mission of the Breast Cancer Research Foundation is to prevent and cure breast cancer by advancing the world's most promising breast cancer research.

feeds.title: Breast Friends Ireland
feeds.description: My name is Teresa Costello, I am 38 years old and I have an 8 year old son called Rhys. In August 2013 at the age of 36 I was diagnosed with Breast Cancer, as you can imagine my diagnosis was a total shock. We want to share our experiences to help ease the fear you may face when diagnosed. Proud to be aligned with Breast Cancer Ireland.

feeds.title: Rethink Breast Cancer
feeds.description: Rethink Breast Cancer is a bold charity helping young people who are concerned about and affected by breast cancer
